title: generator's Cut
description: What the orchestrator gives the generator for one Round, at <round>/generator-cut.json, which the start's prompt names by its path: all the generator gets of the run. Lane's adapter of the rules reads it for the start's steps.

goal.description: The design tree's goal: the end the user is after, and what its people do once it holds.

deliverable.description: The deliverable's node of the design tree as it stands, an open one of design-tree.schema.json: its name, paths, kind, inputs, and each necessary condition with its decisions, the user's answers to its points among them, by user.

inputs.description: The path of each deliverable that the deliverable's inputs name, from the folder that the conversation works in.

best_practice.description: The folder of the best practice that the Round makes by: the deliverable's kind's for content, and the refactoring kind's for refactor.

stage.description: content: the Round makes the content. refactor: it refactors it, once its content is made.

number.description: The Round's number in its stage, from 1.

round.description: The Round's folder, from the folder that the conversation works in, where the role writes its result.

findings.description: What the last evaluator of the deliverable found of each condition that the design tree still holds not good, as it gave it, which the generator takes as given; null before the first evaluator.

good.description: Each condition that the deliverable meets, with the lines that meet it.

condition.description: The condition's ID in the best practice, such as N2.

lines.description: Each line of the deliverable that meets it, word for word as it stands, so that a reader checks the answer by reading them.

more.description: Each condition that the deliverable doesn't yet meet, with what would make it good.

condition.description: The condition's ID in the best practice, such as N2.

good_when.description: What the deliverable's people get once it's good, in their terms, never how to make it, as the generator holds the sources and decides the mend.

last_good.description: What the deliverable's last generator found good as it tried it, as it gave it; null before the first.

oneOf.description: Each condition that the deliverable meets, with the lines that meet it.

condition.description: The condition's ID in the best practice, such as N2.

lines.description: Each line of the deliverable that meets it, word for word as it stands, so that a reader checks the answer by reading them.
